about: Sourcebook power names that are an Ultimate Powers Book power under another name, for the Notable NPCs' links to the Powers section (scripts/msh/npcs.py).

A name that IS a UPB power's name links without an entry here. Only clear equivalents are listed: a book power that is a bundle, a stunt or a character's own trick stays book-only rather than being forced onto the nearest UPB entry.
Keys are the book's name (compared without case or punctuation); values are UPB codes from powers.json.
